subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should newly recognized persona TTS SecretRefs follow the existing startup-required contract now, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: Activating these previously ignored refs can make an existing configuration abort Gateway startup when its optional TTS credential is unavailable; code review cannot decide whether that documented fail-fast behavior remains the intended product policy for TTS.

options.title: Keep current fail-fast contract
options.body: After fixing the current-main collector regression and adding live proof, land this fix with explicit owner acceptance that unavailable active persona TTS refs can abort startup while the broader degradation proposal remains separate.

options.title: Sequence after degradation policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the optional-TTS startup behavior is decided and implemented, then rebase the persona collection work onto that contract.

options.title: Narrow activation scope
options.body: Keep persona targets visible to plan and audit but defer agent-runtime activation, which reduces outage risk but leaves the reported runtime injection bug unresolved.

recommendation.title: Keep current fail-fast contract
recommendation.body: After fixing the current-main collector regression and adding live proof, land this fix with explicit owner acceptance that unavailable active persona TTS refs can abort startup while the broader degradation proposal remains separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the documented secrets activation and Gateway startup contract, an area tied to recent security and contract ownership.
